visualReview.scope: Detailed permanent exterior and visible athletics bowl.
visualReview.notes: All 18 portable and 18 shared final frames inspected, including full-resolution arch bearing, cable network, museum glazing and north-up overlay. Corrected concourse slabs stay under the low goal-end canopy, the tapered struts are continuous, the paired arch ends contact their bearing blocks and the pavilion glass has outward winding. The unequal east/west arches and five-ring museum remain legible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Three canonical shared surfaces use physical repeats: concrete, painted metal and membrane. South half-moon film retains local transparent PBR. Geographic rendering, material resolution and unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped field long edges establish north and central anchor; primary photographs identify the east museum, resolving the 180-degree axis ambiguity. Four turret positions use individual map outlines. North-up overlay agrees with the measured engineering roof extents and asymmetric museum side. Native Y0 is pitch/plaza contact; the 1.011m below-ground cheek-wall foundation depth is explicitly reviewed.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed primary-reference exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: The 2016 engineering paper constrains the 270m chord,260m plan,94/66m unequal arches,paired tube sizes/spacing and six-cable inner ring. Primary contractor and architect references distinguish the retained west structure, new east roof, transparent south film, four stair turrets and five-ring museum. Local membrane curvature, bowl inventory, museum ring tilts, lower facade and unpublished member sections are reconstructed. This is a static exterior visualization, excluding private rooms, exhibits, sponsor artwork and fabrication-level identity.
